correctness.rationale: The canonical auxiliary greedy coin count is proved by terminating exchange moves, Apéry representatives by strict monotonicity, the complete pseudo-Frobenius set by a no-wrap optimal-coin maximality equivalence, and all terminal residues by explicit case analysis. Independent exact Dijkstra replays passed 330 general and 31 repunit cases. The universal proof uses no finite extrapolation.

originality.rationale: The newly established n≡1 and n≡2 mod 3 pseudo-Frobenius spectra for four-term truncations are not the known full-generator or divisible-multiplicity cases. Primary full texts and published-index semantic searches were compared at the level of quantifiers and generated semigroups, not just keywords. A generic Apéry formula covers preliminary data but does not directly state the maximality and type classification. Residual equivalent-corollary and inaccessible-source risks are recorded.
residual_risks: A mathematically equivalent statement may be unindexed or present in the uninspected full-text 2024 generalized two-base triplet chapter; its abstract alone does not prove noncoverage.
General published greedy-Apéry formulas are strong prior coverage; a previously recorded structural corollary could subsume the present maximality analysis.

value.rationale: A natural family of four-generator repunit truncations exhibits an exact three-class type law 2,3,2 and a new unbounded pseudo-Frobenius gap in one class. The two nondivisible classifications are structurally motivated and not supplied by the previously known divisible or full n-generator formulas.
